Observations come from fine-step RK4 wit.ja: 観測は方向を状態に持つ細刻み RK4 で作る。青は雑音入り CTD を 1 m の一定音速層として解析的に逆算した点、赤は一定音速の直線で逆算した点。真の海底や真のロールは推定器へ渡さない。各角度で、実測した曲がりを距離項と角度項の和と比べる。
Observations come from fine-step RK4 wit.zh: Observations come from fine-step RK4 with direction as a state. Blue points use analytic straight segments in 1 m constant-speed layers sampled by a noisy CTD; red points assume one constant speed. Neither true seabed nor true roll enters the estimators. At every angle, measured bend is compared with the sum of range and angular terms.

range term from effective speed.ja: 実効音速による距離項

ceff=L/t is the path-length-weighted har.ja: ceff=L/t は各層の音速を経路長で重み付けした調和平均。第1項は距離のずれ、第2項は屈折で平均角度が変わる寄与。角度が経路内で直線的に変わる近似が無視した曲率項を、外側ビームの曲がりの 25 % 以内とする。
ceff=L/t is the path-length-weighted har.zh: ceff=L/t is the path-length-weighted harmonic mean of layer speeds. The first term is range error; the second is the change in mean direction caused by refraction. The approximation neglects curvature in angle along the path, bounded here to 25% of outer-beam bend.
